summary: Compose σ ↦ σ⁻¹f_b with v ↦ sv, which preserves δ^(b)_F by uniqueness of disintegrations.

steps.claim: The map is the composite of σ ↦ σ⁻¹f_b with the measurable map v ↦ sv.

steps.lean:
((F.isDisintegration_floorVolume b rfl).map s.2 s.1.4).unique (F.isDisintegration_floorVolume b
  ((measurePreserving_floor_block_mulVec hs).of_semiconj (hfm := ⟨by fun_prop, rfl⟩)
  (inclMatrix_mulVec_floor_block b.is_le hs) (by fun_prop)).2)⟩
steps.claim: v ↦ sv carries floorQuadric(F, b) to itself: pushing the disintegration β ↦ floorQuadric(F, b, β) of floorVolume(b) forward by the isometry s gives a disintegration of the image of floorVolume(b), which is floorVolume(b) again because the floor block of s ∈ H_b preserves volume; uniqueness of disintegrations gives equality.
σ ↦ σ⁻¹f_b carries θ^F_b to floorQuadric(F, b).
